findings.newRequireAssessment: require(!antimatter.paused()) cannot block a resume: at that point Antimatter's pauser is the Pauser but it is unregistered, so Pauser.pause() never reaches it (committed EYE-burn pause leaves it unpaused — test_P7_antimatterPausedRequire_unreachable); pause() is onlyPauser; OWNER can unpause (owner-or-pauser). Fail-loud on this attended owner path is correct. A globally-paused suite makes any resume refuse at Phase 0 ('Phase0: strategy paused'), so a resume cannot override an emergency either.

findings.label: L-07
findings.evidence: _preflightOwnerEth (S L319) called only in the non-preview branch before vm.startBroadcast (S L205-218); not in _phase0_preconditions (verifier shares that). Reads vm.rpc eth_getBalance. package.json :broadcast exports CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI (default 300000000) and passes the same $CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI to --with-gas-price in the same && shell chain. Live preview: ETH_BUDGET|SHORTFALL 0.001495 ETH (OWNER 0.006425 < 0.00792) — the preflight would refuse today; that is the fix working (operational: top-up owed).
findings.decision2: Story's premise 'forge pre-funds --sender in its local EVM' NOT REPRODUCED: ProbeOwnerEth.s.sol dry-run (no --broadcast) shows in-EVM balance == eth_getBalance before and after vm.startBroadcast, with --legacy --with-gas-price --skip-simulation --slow. Not tested with --broadcast (audit rule). Using eth_getBalance is authoritative regardless — harmless, justified.
findings.decision3: Justified. Probe: tx.gasprice in the local pass == block.basefee, NOT the --with-gas-price value; legacy txs pay exactly the pinned price, so max(env, tx.gasprice) would only over-demand when base fee > pinned price (where txs would not mine anyway — warned). The two cannot diverge on cost under --legacy --with-gas-price.
findings.budget: Upfront check per tx k needs balance >= (Σ_{i<k} used_i + limit_k)·price ≤ (total used + max late limit)·price = 21,700,173·price < 22,000,000·price; ×1.2 adds ~4.4M gas-equivalent headroom for staker-count growth. Sufficient for the rehearsed shape; derivation from a 25981150 rehearsal, so re-check if staker counts grow materially.
